## What changed

Describe the user-visible or integration-visible change and the evidence behind
it.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run pack:check`
- [ ] New or changed behavior has focused tests
- [ ] Documentation and examples match the shipped interface
- [ ] Reports, fixtures, and screenshots contain no secrets or identifying paths

## Compatibility and boundaries

- [ ] The real Harness profile remains read-only
- [ ] Machine-output changes preserve or intentionally version the JSON contract
- [ ] The change was checked on the relevant operating system or is platform-neutral
